title: ERPBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Enterprise Decision-Making Across Competitive Market Ecologies
abstract: arXiv:2609.04667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for enterprise workflows, yet existing evaluations rarely test whether business-decision conclusions transfer across competitive market ecologies. We introduce ERPBench, an execution-instrumented benchmark for enterprise decision agents in a six-round Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) simulation with coupled pricing, production, procurement, inventory, finance, and shared-market competition. ERPBench evaluates the same 100 fixed problems in two matched competitive market ecologies: Solo, where each evaluated LLM agent competes against fixed rule-based opponents, and Arena, where six evaluated LLM agents compete in a shared market. Across six model families, this yields 1,200 model-level trajectories spanning 7,200 decision rounds. translated_title: ERPBench：评估大语言模型智能体在竞争性市场生态中的企业决策能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被提议用于企业工作流程，但现有评估很少测试商业决策结论是否能在不同的竞争性市场生态之间迁移。我们提出了ERPBench，这是一个面向企业决策智能体的执行级基准测试，基于一个六轮企业资源规划（ERP）模拟，其中耦合了定价、生产、采购、库存、财务以及共享市场竞争。ERPBench在两种匹配的竞争性市场生态中评估相同的100个固定问题：Solo模式（每个被评估的LLM智能体与固定的基于规则的对手竞争）和Arena模式（六个被评估的LLM智能体在共享市场中竞争）。跨越六个模型家族，共产生1,200条模型级轨迹，涵盖7,200个决策轮次。在所观察的服务配置下，领先模型在不同生态中有所不同：DeepSeek在Solo模式中领先（平均估值2.5229亿；平均排名1.67）
tldr: ERPBench是一个新型企业决策智能体基准，通过在Solo和Arena两种竞争性市场生态中开展六轮ERP模拟（耦合定价、生产、采购、库存、财务等决策），评估了六个模型家族共1,200条轨迹，并发现领先模型会随竞争生态的不同而改变。
en_tdlr: ERPBench is a new execution-instrumented benchmark that evaluates LLM agents for enterprise decision-making in six-round ERP simulations across two matched competitive market ecologies (Solo and Arena), spanning 1,200 trajectories over six model families, and reveals that the leading model differs between ecologies.
